scenario: I am an army officer in the Dominican Republic in 1961. For decades now, my country has been governed by a dictator who has kept thousands of people in poverty because of their ethnicity or their political views. I am a member of a group that wants a new start for my country without a civil war. To achieve this goal, I consider it unavoidable to take the dictator into custody in order to disempower him. If I and my accomplices do this, he will be forced to end his regime. If I do not do it, the regime will continue to economically repress a thousand people this year.
choice: I decide to take the dictator into custody
entities: I,the dictator,my accomplices,other people already kept in poverty by the regime because of their ethnicity or political views, excluding the 1000 above
outcomes: The dictator loses freedom of movement.
The dictator is forced to end his regime.
